description: Ranked passage search over this tenant's document store. Lexical (BM25) by default; embeddings mode (set via host.docs.index_config) ranks by cosine and falls back to lexical (index.mode: "lexical-fallback") if the provider call fails. Returns [{document_id, name, version, chunk_no, offset, text, score}] plus an index block naming the mode and how stale the index is.

filter.description: Restrict results to documents matching prefix and/or name.

name.description: Only match this exact document name.

prefix.description: Only match documents whose name starts with this prefix.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.docs.search
